spec_match.rationale: Builds the exact MediaDecodingConfiguration/MediaCapabilitiesKeySystemConfiguration/KeySystemTrackConfiguration shape from the spec IDL, including null vs "" vs registry values (cenc/cbcs/cbcs-1-9) and a bogus-scheme honesty detector derived from the spec's unrecognized-scheme rule.

interactive.rationale: Eight real controls compose the dictionary, the button invokes the real navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo(), and both the configuration passed and the result received (including keySystemAccess presence) are printed live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb promises a query builder that calls the real API and reports keySystemAccess presence; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers null default, empty-string-as-unrecognized, custom/bogus schemes, the clear-query toggle, and surfaces real rejections with the error name when the dictionary is malformed.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/4644898109259776 and the KeySystemTrackConfiguration spec section.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the positive contract, the null/""/bogus distinctions, keySystemAccess coupling, and three TypeError rejections; the two 152-only assertions fail honestly on pre-152 browsers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified in headless Chromium 141 via a Playwright/CDP driver (desktop+mobile, autorun exercised, console clean except the environmental fonts.googleapis.com failure) — but this sandbox has no Chrome 152, so only the honest 'member dropped' path was observed, and chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert fires for detection machinery, honored-state, resolved queries, and separately (never as a pass) for the rejected/unavailable fallback branches.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables are used, statuses sit on bg-stone with text-black, no button background overrides, and focus-visible outlines are explicit.

accessibility.rationale: All controls are native labelled selects/inputs/buttons, min-height 2.75rem tap targets, focus-visible outlines, and the status/detector readouts are aria-live polite text equivalents of the visual state.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: zero horizontal overflow after fixing the long-token breadcrumb/code wrapping and select min-width, controls stack single-column on mobile, screenshots of both classes reviewed.

openQuestions.title: Verify the honored path on real Chrome 152
openQuestions.detail: This sandbox tops out at Chromium 141, where KeySystemTrackConfiguration.encryptionScheme is dropped by dictionary conversion, so the detector's 'honored' branch and the two 152-only conformance assertions have only been observed failing honestly. Re-run the page and /conformance/ on Chrome 152 or Canary with the feature enabled and confirm the bogus-scheme query flips to supported:false.

openQuestions.title: Exercise audio-track encryptionScheme
openQuestions.detail: keySystemConfiguration.audio also takes a KeySystemTrackConfiguration with encryptionScheme; the builder only composes the video track. A concept combining audio+video tracks with differing schemes would cover the remaining dictionary surface.

openQuestions.title: Widevine/PlayReady paths only show honest failure here
openQuestions.detail: The sandbox Chromium has no Widevine or PlayReady CDM, so those key-system options were verified only as honest supported:false results. Spot-check on a desktop Chrome with Widevine that robustness+scheme combinations return real answers.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form controls select aria-live status announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements with real labels; expose async state changes through polite live regions rather than visual-only updates.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native labelled select/input/button; the query status and the honored-detector message are aria-live=polite outputs mirroring the visual state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table matrix mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give grid/flex children min-width:0, let long tokens wrap with overflow-wrap, and keep wide content scrolling inside its own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls grid uses minmax(min(14rem,100%),1fr) with min-width:0 labels and width:100% selects; long API tokens in breadcrumbs/inline code get overflow-wrap:anywhere; result JSON scrolls inside its pre. Verified 0px document overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: form control labelling and timely feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every field and surface responses next to the action without premature error states.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each select/input is wrapped in a visible label; the run button's outcome (resolved values or the real rejection name/message) lands directly below with an explicit in-flight state.

summary: Interactive dictionary builder for decodingInfo() keySystemConfiguration with the new encryptionScheme member; includes a spec-derived bogus-scheme detector that honestly reported 'NOT honored' on this sandbox's Chromium 141 while ClearKey null/cenc queries resolved supported:true with a granted MediaKeySystemAccess.
